usage: icebath sessions [-h]
                        {list,export,delete,prune,archive,optimize,clean-markers,optimize-storage,repair,set-journal-mode,repair-routing,repair-profiles,repair-prompts,refresh-prompts,recover,stats,rename,discard,adopt,pin,unpin,pinned,retitle-skills,browse,import} ...

View and manage the SQLite session store

positional arguments:
  {list,export,delete,prune,archive,optimize,clean-markers,optimize-storage,repair,set-journal-mode,repair-routing,repair-profiles,repair-prompts,refresh-prompts,recover,stats,rename,discard,adopt,pin,unpin,pinned,retitle-skills,browse,import}
    list                List recent sessions
    export              Export sessions to JSONL, Markdown, or QMD
    delete              Delete a specific session
    prune               Delete old sessions (filterable by time window, source, title, ...)
    archive             Bulk-archive (soft-hide) sessions matching filters — no deletion
    optimize            Reclaim disk space: merge FTS5 segments + VACUUM (no data change)
    clean-markers       Permanently clear stale tool-call marker content left by sessions from
                        before #78148
    optimize-storage    Migrate the search index to the compact v23 layout (reclaims disk on large
                        DBs)
    repair              Repair a malformed state.db schema so hidden sessions reappear
    set-journal-mode    Convert state.db between journal_mode=WAL and DELETE offline (every holder
                        stopped)
    repair-routing      Re-stamp gateway sessions that lost their routing identity
    repair-profiles     Settle session/routing state that landed under the wrong profile
    repair-prompts      Report or clear stored system prompts degraded to a reduced-toolset build
    refresh-prompts     Make continuing sessions rebuild their system prompt on their next turn
    recover             Rebuild canonical session data into a separate clean database
    stats               Show session store statistics
    rename              Set or change a session's title
    discard             Acknowledge turns lost in a gateway crash (unknown admissions) so the
                        session runs again
    adopt               Bring this profile's pre-gateway chats under its gateway (run on the host)
    pin                 Pin session(s) — durable keep flag, exempt from auto-archive
    unpin               Remove the pin (durable keep flag) from session(s)
    pinned              List pinned sessions
    retitle-skills      Re-title sessions whose auto-title came from a /skill's own text
    browse              Interactive session picker — browse, search, and resume sessions
    import              Import a Claude Code or Codex CLI session into Icebath

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
